Participation Requirements 2(b): 'you must include your Associates ID or “tag” ... as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site'. 2(b): prices may be shown only if Amazon serves the link or the data comes via Creators API or PA API. 2(t): customer reviews and star ratings only via Creators API or PA API. 2(y): no price tracking or price alerting. 2(w): no link shortening that obscures an Amazon destination. irregularities_found_this_pass.summary: The audit page cited the ASIN definition to an unrelated Sell on Amazon article (the FBA New Selection post) while the citation register cited the correct ASIN guide. Both pages now point at the ASIN guide, and the flag is published.

The audit source register titled S04 'Standard Commission Income Rates (Table 1)' when the page is the 'Associates Program Standard Commission Income Statement'. Title corrected; the rates themselves were re-read today.
The audit page had no link back to the citation register, so the two evidence surfaces were not navigable from each other. Navigation corrected.

The published review page rendered only the four-row intake register. The ten recorded flags and the ten secondary-session flags were never published anywhere, even though the board marked them 'published on the Flagged for Review page'. They are published now.

Product links carried rel="sponsored" but no Associates tag parameter, so no click could ever be attributed. S02 2(b) requires the tag in the URL of each link placed on the site. Links now carry exactly the submitted tracking ID and nothing else.

The guides described a 'product to research' link as 'not a paid link' while the same anchor carried rel="sponsored". The wording now says what is true: the link carries the submitted tracking ID and no click has been confirmed.
